scope: Bounded description-selection smoke cases, not automatic routing or full workflow effectiveness proof. Expectations set before model runs; alternative adequate owners must be explained, not silently scored as failures.

cases.task: Draft a GitHub issue from the supplied bug reproduction. Return the text only; do not implement or publish anything.
cases.boundary: Draft only, no staging or publication.

cases.task: Write a PR description for the supplied final diff and validation results. Do not change code, stage files or open the PR.
cases.boundary: Submission text, not delivery.

cases.task: Review only the staged change that restores a missing public export. Identify supported defects without editing anything.
cases.boundary: Exact staged candidate; an export-contract test can be adequate narrow evidence.

cases.task: Compare two concrete module interface designs for the cache boundary. Return the tradeoffs; do not implement either design.
cases.boundary: Known-boundary design, not architecture audit or implementation.

cases.task: Plan a schema migration while old and new service versions must both keep reading and writing. Do not run the migration.
cases.boundary: Compatibility plan, no live writes.

cases.task: Map the instructions, behavior owner, toolchain and safe test commands in this unfamiliar repository. Do not change the code or install dependencies.
cases.boundary: Orientation, not delivery or broad redesign.

cases.task: From saved Pi history for this project over the last seven days, summarize recorded usage and cost. Do not search other projects.
cases.boundary: Bounded Pi history, not causal diagnosis or all-history scan.

cases.task: The coding agent ignored a correction midway through a session. Find the first wrong decision from the session evidence; do not restart or steer it.
cases.boundary: Causal diagnosis, not automatic session mutation.

cases.task: Design the schema, errors and result contract for a new agent-facing search tool. Do not audit the whole agent environment.
cases.boundary: Tool contract design, not general agent application architecture.

cases.task: Audit the coding-agent environment for duplicated capabilities and instruction conflicts. Return recommendations without changing configuration.
cases.boundary: Read-only environment audit.

cases.task: Use hc terminals to delegate an isolated implementation and a separate read-only review, collect results and clean up the children.
cases.boundary: Parent-addressed reporting; read-only collection must respect host approval policy.

cases.task: Use this harness's native subagent facility for a small side question. Do not use hc or terminal delegation.
cases.boundary: hc-specific skill must stay unused.

cases.task: Assess and apply the requested patch update of this dependency, checking the lockfile and install scripts. Do not upgrade unrelated packages.
cases.boundary: Authorized narrow update, no universal extra approval pause.

cases.task: Screen sharing is broken in my Fedora desktop session. Diagnose the portal/session boundary first; do not install packages or change SELinux.
cases.boundary: Generic desktop diagnosis before distro package/policy overlay.

cases.task: Investigate an SELinux denial caused by a Fedora package's file labels. Preserve enforcement and propose the scoped repair.
cases.boundary: Fedora policy overlay; no blanket disablement.

cases.task: Review the supplied report for factual inconsistencies, arithmetic errors and conclusions not supported by its evidence. Do not rewrite it.
cases.boundary: Findings, not author self-editing.

cases.task: Rewrite this paragraph for a nontechnical reader, preserving its claims and uncertainty. Return the paragraph only.
cases.boundary: Point revision, not independent review or research.

cases.task: Inspect this changed code's resource ownership and cancellation boundaries using the applicable language guidance. No score and no implementation.
cases.boundary: Judgment assessment; code-review also adequate if treating the request as candidate review, no second coordinator.

cases.task: Repair a flaky test that assumes two outputs have completed after a fixed delay. Diagnose the actual completion condition before changing the wait.
cases.boundary: Observable output completion, not nominal elapsed ticks.

cases.task: What is 7 plus 5? Answer directly.
cases.boundary: No specialist workflow for trivial settled arithmetic.
